fact: Creepers came from a failed pig model.
A Creeper flashes before exploding.
Lightning can turn a Creeper into a charged Creeper.
Endermen are damaged by water and rain.
Endermen can pick up certain blocks.
An activated End portal sends you to the End.
The dragon egg appears after the first Ender Dragon defeat.
The Nether is a dangerous lava-filled dimension.
Netherite gear is more durable than diamond gear.
Ancient debris is used to make netherite.
Ghasts shoot explosive fireballs.
Blazes drop blaze rods used for progression.
The Wither is a player-summoned boss.
Ocean Monuments are guarded by guardians.
Sponges can absorb nearby water.
Axolotls can help fight underwater enemies.
Dolphins can give nearby swimmers a speed boost.
Baby turtles drop scutes when they grow up.
Villagers can take professions from job-site blocks.
Emeralds are the main currency for villager trading.
Iron golems protect villages and can be built by players.
Cats can scare creepers away.
Phantoms can appear after players avoid sleeping for several in-game days.
Beds explode when used in the Nether or End.
Respawn anchors can set a Nether respawn point.
A lodestone can make a compass point to a chosen location.
A recovery compass points toward your last death location.
Beacons can provide powerful status effects.
Enchanting uses experience and lapis lazuli.
Anvils can repair, rename, and combine items.
Grindstones can remove most enchantments.
Smithing tables upgrade equipment and handle armor trims.
Redstone powers machines and logic systems.
Pistons can push blocks when powered.
Sticky pistons can pull blocks back.
Observers detect block updates and output redstone pulses.
Hoppers move items between inventories.
Dispensers can activate or launch certain items.
Note blocks can make different musical notes.
Mending repairs equipment using collected experience.
Fortune can increase certain block drops.
Silk Touch lets you collect certain blocks in their original form.
Unbreaking gives items a chance to avoid durability loss.
Efficiency makes many tools break blocks faster.
Feather Falling reduces fall damage.
Respiration increases underwater breathing time.
Depth Strider makes underwater movement faster.
The Warden is designed to be avoided rather than casually fought.
Ancient Cities generate deep underground in the deep dark.
Allays can collect matching dropped items.
Copper changes appearance as it oxidizes.
Lightning rods attract lightning strikes.
Amethyst geodes contain budding amethyst and clusters.
Spyglasses let players zoom their view.
Powder snow can make entities sink into it.
Goats can ram nearby entities.
Bees collect pollen and return to their nests or hives.
Honey bottles can remove poison.
Honey blocks have special sticky movement properties.
Large slimes can split into smaller slimes.
Witches use potions during combat.
Vexes are flying mobs summoned by evokers.
Raids attack villages under the right conditions.
A Totem of Undying can save you from lethal damage when held correctly.
Woodland Mansions are rare illager structures.
Strongholds contain End portals.
Eyes of ender help locate strongholds.
Ender pearls teleport players when thrown.
Golden apples provide powerful temporary effects.
A water bucket can save you from fall damage.
A lava bucket is both a weapon and a strong furnace fuel source.
Soul sand creates upward bubble columns underwater.
Magma blocks create downward bubble columns underwater.
Boats can transport players and many mobs.
Minecarts travel along rails.
Elytra let players glide through the air.
Firework rockets can boost elytra flight.
Shulker boxes keep their contents when broken.
Ender chests provide personal shared storage.
Furnaces smelt and cook using fuel.
Blast furnaces process certain materials faster.
Smokers cook food faster than regular furnaces.
Campfires can cook food without normal furnace fuel.
Torches provide light and help prevent hostile spawning under applicable rules.
Glass is made by smelting sand.
Concrete powder becomes concrete when it contacts water.
Sheep can be sheared for wool.
Milk removes many status effects.
Striders can walk across lava.
Piglins generally become hostile to players not wearing gold armor.
Piglins can barter when given gold ingots.
Bastion Remnants are dangerous Nether structures.
Nether fortresses contain blazes and wither skeletons.
Mushroom fields are rare and have unusual mob-spawning behavior.
Mooshrooms can provide mushroom stew.
Pandas have different personalities and behaviors.
Bamboo grows quickly and can be used for building.
Scaffolding helps players build upward safely.
TNT explodes when primed.
Gunpowder is used for TNT and fireworks.
